paper.title: Risk-Aware Decision Making in Restless Bandits: Theory and Algorithms for Planning and Learning

unmapped: Episodic finite-horizon restless bandit: N arms, each a finite-state non-stationary MDP with unknown transition probabilities; agent activates at most M arms per step
Learner observes the full state of all arms (state transitions of every arm), not just a scalar reward
Risk-aware objective: sum over arms of a non-decreasing Lipschitz utility of each arm's cumulative reward; history-dependent policies
Rewards deterministic, known, in [r_min, r_max] with r_min >= 0
Regret measured over K episodes of length T against the optimal policy of the true model
settings.definition_quote: Given a set of $N$ arms~$(\mathcal{X}^i, \mathcal{A}, \{P^i_t(a)\}_{a \in \{0, 1\}, t \in \mathcal{T}}, \{r^i_t\}_{t \in \mathcal{T}}, x^i_0)$, $i \in {\cal N}$, where at most $M \le N$ can be activated at a time, find a sequence of history-dependent policies $\left\{{\bs \pi}_k\right\}_{k \geq 1}$ that minimizes $\REGRET(K)$.

algorithms.name: LRAP-TS (Learning Risk-Aware Policy using Thompson Sampling)
I-RAWIP-TSDE (Thompson Sampling with Dynamic Episodes, risk-aware Whittle index)

symbols.N_arms: number of arms (restless bandit processes), paper's N
symbols.X_bar: maximum state-space size over arms, max_i |X^i|

conditions: parameters of different arms independent under the prior; compact parameter sets

source.label: thm:regret
source.quote: The expected regret defined in \eqref{eq:reg-def} under the LRAP-TS algorithm is bounded by: \[{\REGRET}(K) \leq 12 N^2 T r_{\max}\bar{|\mathcal{X}|} \sqrt{KT (1 + \log (KT))}.\]

results.notes: Bayesian regret over K episodes vs the optimal risk-aware policy of the true model. Paper's T (episode length) mapped to H, K (episodes) to K_ep, N (arms) to N_arms. Compute marked exponential because LRAP-TS computes the optimal policy of the sampled joint system, which the paper notes is intractable for large N. Lemma 11 (transition estimation error 12 N X_bar sqrt(KT(1+log KT))) is an intermediate step, not recorded.
